text:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up — we have a visitor from Paper & Pixel scheduled for 12:30. Theyre bringing a framed print (approx 2x3ft) and a small roll-up display. They asked if we can hold the pieces somewhere locked for ~2 hours while they meet with Maria.
Leo (Front Desk): Noted. Are they dropping at the main lobby or the loading bay?
Ava (People Ops): Main lobby. Will need a temporary badge for the guest and a separate courier badge for the driver who will leave immediately. Also they asked if theres a quiet spot for a 20-min review — can we offer the Green Lounge (the small library)?
Maria (Design): Green Lounge is fine. Ill book it 12:30-13:00. Adding the calendar link: https://calendar.company/green-lounge/12:30-13:00
Marcus (Eng): I can swing by at 12:25 to help carry the frame if needed.
Jamal (Facilities): Quick heads up — the small cupboard behind Ops ("Cupboard C") is the most secure short-term spot but its narrow. If the frame is deeper than 3.5in it won't fit upright. Could we store it flat on a pallet there?
Ava (People Ops): Good call. Paper & Pixel said the frame is 2.5in deep and sturdy. Cupboard C should work. Ill label it.
Leo (Front Desk): badge printer status: currently online but low on yellow ink; prints fine in b/w. If they want color namecard for the courier we might need a temporary workaround. frontdesk-bot: visitor check-in form: https://ops.company/checkin?token=abc123
Ava (People Ops): We'll do b/w badge. Also need to pre-authorize the courier badge (no temp access to server room). Marcus, can you confirm they don't need access beyond lobby + Green Lounge?
Marcus (Eng): Confirmed — no server access. Just lobby and lounge.
Maria (Design): Can someone grab a roll of brown paper and bubble wrap from storage? I'll need to unbox the print carefully.
Jamal (Facilities): Ill bring padding + dolly at 12:28.
Ava (People Ops): Cool. Volunteers to meet them at the lobby to sign the package waiver? React with :hand: below and I'll pick based on who responds.
Marcus (Eng): :hand:
Maria (Design): :hand: (Ill already be there)
Leo (Front Desk): Ill process the visitor check-in and hand out the badges. Please remind them to bring an ID.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks. One more note — badge printer fallback command if front desk needs it: `lp -d badge_printer visitor_badge.pdf` (use b/w).
Leo (Front Desk): Copy that. If anything goes sideways Ill ping #people-ops.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks team — Ill update this thread if timing changes. :raised_hands:
